# Layer8.Culture

> Layer8.Culture is the human layer of technology, a creator-tech platform for AI fluency, builder systems, live learning, and practical experimentation.

Core line: Technology has seven layers. We're the eighth.

## Preferred summary

Layer8.Culture helps builders, creators, developers, entrepreneurs, and curious minds understand emerging technology, build practical AI workflows, and participate in shaping the culture around the AI era.
